title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban):
summary: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban): — Flagship scheme comprehensively covered in the Government Schemes Consolidated Masterfile.

blocks.title: 🏛️ Canonical Reference & Masterfile Integration
blocks.text: This flagship scheme is comprehensively detailed in the Government Schemes Masterfile (Section: "migrated-schemes-masterfile"). Key highlights and parameters are summarized below.

items: o Objective: Affordable housing for all by 2024.
o Target: 1.25 crore houses, 86 lakh completed.
o No pucca house in India.
 BLC: Support for individuals to build homes.
 AHP: Government-private partnerships for affordable homes.
 ISS: Interest subsidy on home loans for EWS/LIG.
